# Telemetry conventions

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alphalattice.actor_id` | string | The actor responsible for this operation. |
| `alphalattice.actor_kind` | string | The kind of actor responsible for this operation. |
| `alphalattice.call_parent` | string | The CLI call's parent span ID, sent as baggage. |
| `alphalattice.call_started_us` | string | The CLI call start time in Unix microseconds, sent as baggage. |
| `alphalattice.command` | string | The CLI command name, sent as baggage. |
| `alphalattice.goal_id` | string | The goal this operation serves. |
| `alphalattice.node` | string | The process role which emitted the observation. |
| `alphalattice.selection_id` | string | The selection this operation serves. |
| `alphalattice.subject_id` | string | The identity of the observed subject. |
| `alphalattice.subject_kind` | string | The category of the observed subject. |
| `alphalattice.trial_id` | string | The research trial this operation serves. |
| `alphalattice.workspace_id` | string | The workspace this operation serves. |
| `call` | string | The worker's qualified callable name. |
| `caller` | string | The command or surface that initiated the product operation. |
| `channel` | string | The phase or progress channel of the Task. |
| `code` | string | The code of the question shown to the person. |
| `command` | string | The CLI command name. |
| `event_kind` | string | The type of activity reported by an agent client. |
| `exit_code` | int | The CLI process exit code. |
| `failure_code` | string | The product refusal code. |
| `goal_id` | string | The goal inherited by a recorded CLI or worker span. |
| `links` | string[] | The preceding trace and span identifiers for linked CLI calls. |
| `operation` | string | The product operation or request route. |
| `route` | string | The request method and matched route. |
| `selection_id` | string | The selection inherited by a worker span returned to its Host. |
| `source` | string | The telemetry source path for the Task. |
| `state` | string | Whether the question was asked or answered. |
| `trial_id` | string | The trial inherited by a worker span returned to its Host. |
| `unattributed` | boolean | Whether the caller could not be attributed. |

## Spans

| Span type | Required attributes | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cli.call` | `command` | A CLI invocation recorded by the Host. |
| `gen_ai.execute_tool` | `gen_ai.operation.name`, `gen_ai.tool.name` | Describes tool execution span. |
| `gen_ai.invoke_agent.internal` | `gen_ai.operation.name` | Describes an in-process GenAI agent, workflow, or framework entrypoint invocation. |
| `gen_ai.memory.client` | `gen_ai.memory.store.id`, `gen_ai.operation.name` | Describes a memory operation, including memory store lifecycle operations and memory record operations. |
| `gen_ai.retrieval` | `gen_ai.operation.name` | Describes a retrieval operation - an execution of a framework retrieval pipeline that returns documents relevant to a query. |
| `host.request` | `operation` | A request served by the Host. |
| `product.operation` | `caller`, `operation` | A product operation served by the Host. |
| `task.telemetry` | `channel`, `source` | A Task progress update or completed phase. |
| `worker.call` | `call` | A worker call serving a Host step. |

## Events

| Event | Required attributes |
| --- | --- |
| `agent.activity` | `event_kind` |
| `artifact.verified` | — |
| `clock.correlated` | — |
| `person.question` | `code`, `state` |
| `request.refused` | `caller`, `failure_code`, `operation` |
| `task.transition` | — |
